[[File:Godsheart.png|thumb|250px|[[The Godsheart]] was a pulsar.]]
A '''pulsar''' was a rapidly rotating [[Neutron star/Legends|neutron star]].<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref> There were several pulsars in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> including [[2GS-91E20]],<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> the [[Bedlam Pulsar/Legends|Bedlam Pulsar]], the [[Din Pulsar/Legends|Din Pulsar]], [[the Godsheart]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Oolex Pulsar/Legends|Oolex Pulsar]],<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> the [[Thornhedge Pulsar]],<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Vestor Pulsar]].<ref name="Goroth">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref> A [[Unidentified pulsar|pulsar]] was also located within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Riptide">[[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']]</ref> They were considered to be natural hazards.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

{{Star-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Pulsars were first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]'', a [[1993]] [[West End Games]] supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', and a pulsar first made an [[in-universe]] appearance in the [[2011]] novel [[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']], written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].
